summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on experience in Git/GitLab version control, Python, and C/C++ across Linux-based embedded and robotics systems. Deployed a Jetson-side service via systemd on Linux and published an installable Python package using setuptools, and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through hands-on debugging of a distributed, multi-component pipeline. Comfortable working independently across parallel technical tasks under time pressure.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.
Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) across a three-layer distributed pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart, non-root isolation) on Linux with static IP networking; configured XRDP for remote administration of the headless Jetson.

projects.name: Haptics Research Study Controller — Embedded Rig + PyQt6 Host
bullets: Added command-level reliability (echo matching, 400 ms ACK timeout, 3 retries, brown-out reset detection), eliminating a silent failure in the prior app.
Built a 36-trial state machine with hold/resume across USB dropouts and end-to-end tests against a simulated board.

projects.name: ImageSteganography — Published Python Package
bullets: Published ImageSteganography v2.0.0 as an installable Python package (setuptools wheel + sdist) for keyed image steganography, storing one character per sampled pixel via decimal-digit substitution across BGR channels with OpenCV and NumPy.
Derived the pixel-sampling stride from the password, embedded length and verification data in a header pixel, and measured embedding distortion with PSNR between cover and stego images.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
